name: groups duplicates by size and content
input: two duplicate groups and one unique file

name: does not read unique-size files
input: one unique-size file plus a same-size pair
test:
data = {'unique.bin': b'abcde', 'x.bin': b'aa', 'y.bin': b'bb'}
files = [('unique.bin', 5), ('x.bin', 2), ('y.bin', 2)]
reads = []
def read_file(path):
    reads.append(path)
    return data[path]
assert find_duplicate_files(files, read_file) == []
assert sorted(reads) == ['x.bin', 'y.bin']

name: empty files can be duplicates
same size with different bytes is not duplicate
